title: Display a value
prompt: The robot needs a way to display any number. Write `display`, which takes one value and prints it. `display_twice` receives n; make it call display with n, then with n times 2, so display_twice(3) prints 3 and then 6.

tests.name: n is printed, then n times 2

hints: A parameter is a name in the brackets of the definition; whatever the caller passes in is stored under that name.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
